https://www.shadycreekcolorado.com/rooms-rates | Colorado RV Park Rates
pages.lines:
Our sites are spacious and can accommodate rigs up to 46 ft. Rv with multiple slides, plenty of room to park your towed vehicle. Two vehicle limit unless prior approval.  All sites are 30 amp with  metered electric service, we are working on adding 50 amp services.  WiFi, great city water, city sewer, on-site trash, laundry and BBQ area for park gatherings.   All sites are winterized.
What we offer here at Shady Creek is peaceful, quiet and shady sites.  We do allow pets.  Dogs must be on a leash at all times. They cannot be left alone outside tied up. Barking dogs will not be tolerated.  You MUST clean up after them.  Rates are based on two people, each additional person will be $2.00 per person per day which is the standard in all RV parks.
Cancellations must be 48 hours prior to your reservation or one night will be charged to your credit card per site!
